prompt: Compare the two images, shown in chronological order as the first and last frames, and follow the elements relative to the stationary background. Your task is to identify the horizontal motion signal and decide whether it points left or right relative to the background. Some or all elements may move in that direction; other elements, when present, can move in different directions. The signal does not have to be carried by a majority of the elements. Consider their movements between the two images, not which side contains more elements in a single image. Object appearance, orientation, and identity do not determine the answer. Judge displacement between the first and last frames rather than where an element happens to finish. Give your final answer as exactly one uppercase word: LEFT or RIGHT.
source_video_prompt: Watch the moving elements against the stationary background and follow their positions over time. Your task is to identify the horizontal motion signal and decide whether it points left or right relative to the background. Some or all elements may move in that direction; other elements, when present, can move in different directions. The signal does not have to be carried by a majority of the elements. Consider their movements across the video, not which side contains more elements in a single image. Object appearance, orientation, and identity do not determine the answer. Judge displacement across successive moments rather than where an element happens to finish. Give your final answer as exactly one uppercase word: LEFT or RIGHT.
